entities.name: Lewis Hamilton
entities.description: Hamilton was able to win with a dominant car, with a good car like 2010 or 2012, or with bad cars like 2009 and 2011.

entities.name: Fernando Alonso
entities.description: Alonso later described Hamilton as one of the top five greatest drivers of all time.

entities.name: Sebastian Vettel
entities.description: Hamilton joined Vettel in paying tribute to Alonso by driving in formation.
